veg.make_ahead: Cut the chips up to 1 day ahead in cold water in the fridge and the haloumi into fingers up to 1 day ahead, chilled; batter and fry on the night

steps.text: Whisk the flour, cornflour and lager to a batter.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry them.
Fry the chips in the oil twice, first at a lower heat, then hot to crisp.
Pat the haloumi fingers dry, dip in the batter and fry at 180C until golden.
Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.

veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the chips and haloumi fingers up to 1 day ahead and chill; whisk the soda water batter fresh so it stays fizzy

steps.text: Whisk the flour, cornflour and soda water to a batter.
Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry them.
Fry the chips in the oil twice, first at a lower heat, then hot to crisp.
Pat the haloumi fingers dry, dip in the batter and fry at 180C until golden.
Serve in paper cones with tartare and lemon.

veg.n: Madison's whole roast cauliflower with drawn butter
veg.make_ahead: Boil the cauliflowers up to 1 day ahead, drained and chilled; split, brush and grill on the night

steps.text: Boil the whole cauliflowers in water with the salt until a knife slides in.
Melt half the butter with the garlic. Melt the rest for drawn butter.
Split the cauliflowers in half lengthways and brush the cut sides with the garlic butter.
Grill cut side up until golden at the edges.
Serve with the drawn butter and lemon.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches until they lose their water.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, cumin, chipotles and stock.
Simmer until the sweet potato starts to break down and thicken the pot.
Add the kidney beans and simmer until thick.
Ladle into bowls with cheddar.

veg.n: Dee-Luxe veggie dogs with the works
veg.make_ahead: Brown and simmer the chilli up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; griddle the hot dogs and dice the onion on the night

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince in the oil, then simmer with the cumin, chilli powder and water until loose.
Griddle the vegetarian hot dogs and steam the buns.
Dice the onion.
Fill the buns with the hot dogs and top with chilli, mustard, raw onion and relish.

veg.n: Easter Sunday roast cauliflower with mint sauce
veg.make_ahead: Mint sauce up to 1 day ahead, roast fresh

steps.text: Trim the cauliflowers, boil whole for 8 minutes and drain well.
Cut small slits all over and push in slivers of garlic and rosemary sprigs. Rub with half the oil, melted butter and salt.
Peel the potatoes and parboil them.
Roast the cauliflowers and the potatoes in the rest of the oil at 200C until deep golden.
For mint sauce, chop the mint with the sugar, add a splash of boiling water and the malt vinegar.
Toss the peas in the rest of the butter and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can be pressed and marinated a day ahead

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, cut into 4 slabs

steps.text: Press the tofu dry and marinate in the soy and smoked paprika.
Dip the rice paper in water, wrap two sheets around each tofu slab and brush with the oil.
Roast at 230C, turning once, until the rice paper puffs and blisters like crackling. Sprinkle with the salt flakes.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Simmer the apples with the water into a sauce.
Slice the tofu and serve over the mash with apple sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Better made 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Brown the sliced mushrooms and smoked tofu in the oil in batches.
Soften the carrots, onion and garlic in the same pot, then stir in the tomato paste and flour.
Return the mushrooms and tofu, add the wine, stock, thyme and bay leaves and bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently uncovered until the sauce is glossy and thick.
Glaze the pearl onions and button mushrooms in the butter and stir through at the end.

veg_af.make_ahead: Better made 1 day ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Brown the sliced mushrooms and smoked tofu in the oil in batches.
Soften the carrots, onion and garlic in the same pot, then stir in the tomato paste and flour.
Return the mushrooms and tofu, add the stock, extra stock, vinegar, soy, thyme and bay leaves and bring to a simmer.
Simmer gently uncovered until the sauce is glossy and thick.
Glaze the pearl onions and button mushrooms in the butter and stir through at the end.

veg.make_ahead: Fry and crumble the vegetarian sausages up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Slice the vegetarian sausages and fry in the oil with the fennel seeds until browned, then crumble.
Stretch the dough thin into two bases and spread with the crushed tomato, seasoned with salt.
Top with mozzarella and the crumbled sausage.
Bake each pizza at max heat until the crust blisters.

veg.n: Mess hall lentil and mushroom loaf
veg.make_ahead: Bake the loaf up to 1 day ahead until firm, then cool and keep chilled; reheat slices and make the mash on the night

steps.text: Grate the onion and fry with the mushrooms in the oil until dry.
Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs and soy sauce.
Press into a lined loaf tin and glaze with the tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C until firm. Boil the potatoes while it bakes.
Rest the loaf, mash the potatoes with butter and milk and serve thick slices.

veg.n: Ohio barbecue cauliflower steaks with corn and slaw
veg.make_ahead: Cauliflower can be rubbed up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Cut each cauliflower into two thick steaks through the core. Rub with the oil, paprika, sugar and salt, then wrap in foil.
Bake at 200C until tender.
Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and finish over hot coals until sticky.
Grill the corn. Toss the cabbage, carrot and mayonnaise into a crunchy coleslaw.

veg.make_ahead: Creamed spinach up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks and roast in half the oil at 220C until crisp.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the rest of the oil until browned, baste with butter and garlic, then finish in the oven.
Wilt the spinach and simmer with the cream until thick.
Serve the cauliflower steaks with the potatoes and creamed spinach.

veg.n: Fezzik's giant mushroom and lentil pie
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days, bake fresh

steps.text: Slice the onions. Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions and thyme and cook until soft, then stir in the flour and tomato paste.
Add the soy sauce, stock and lentils and simmer until thick.
Pour into a large pie dish and cool slightly.
Cover with puff pastry, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C.

veg.n: Valentine's portobello steaks with garlic butter
veg.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep in the fridge; sear the mushrooms and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until just tender, drain, smash flat on a tray, drizzle with half the oil and roast at 220C.
Season the portobellos and sear in the rest of the oil, gill side up first, until browned on both sides.
Add most of the butter, the garlic and thyme and baste. Lift out the mushrooms.
Add the wine and stock to the pan and reduce by half.
Saute the beans in the remaining butter. Serve with the mushrooms and potatoes.

veg_af.n: Valentine's portobello steaks with garlic butter
veg_af.make_ahead: Boil the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep in the fridge; sear the mushrooms and make the sauce on the night

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until just tender, drain, smash flat on a tray, drizzle with half the oil and roast at 220C.
Season the portobellos and sear in the rest of the oil, gill side up first, until browned on both sides.
Add most of the butter, the garlic and thyme and baste. Lift out the mushrooms.
Add the stock, extra stock and vinegar to the pan and reduce by half.
Saute the beans in the remaining butter. Serve with the mushrooms and potatoes.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

ingredients.item: large eggplants, cut into 4 thick slices lengthways

steps.text: Salt the eggplant slices for 10 minutes, pat dry and crumb in flour, egg and panko.
Shallow fry in the oil until golden and tender.
Simmer the tomato with the garlic.
Top with smoked tofu, tomato and mozzarella and grill until bubbling.
Serve with hot chips and a green salad.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the portobellos and chop the shallots up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; sear and make the sauce just before serving

steps.text: Sear the portobellos in the oil for 3 minutes a side, then set aside.
In the same pan soften the shallots and garlic in the butter, add the brandy and flame.
Stir in the mustard, soy sauce, stock and cream and reduce.
Return the mushrooms to coat in the sauce.

veg_af.make_ahead: Slice the portobellos and chop the shallots up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; sear and make the sauce on the night

ingredients.item: apple juice with 1 tsp cider vinegar

steps.text: Sear the portobellos in the oil for 3 minutes a side, then set aside.
In the same pan soften the shallots and garlic in the butter, add the apple juice mix and let it bubble.
Stir in the mustard, soy sauce, stock and cream and reduce.
Return the mushrooms to coat in the sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Dough can be made a day ahead

steps.text: Rest the dough at room temperature so it relaxes. Season the tomatoes with salt and oregano.
Stretch the bases thin, spread with sauce and top with the mozzarella and plant-based pepperoni.
Bake on a preheated tray at the oven's highest setting until bubbling and golden.

veg.n: Puzzle box haloumi and mushroom souvlaki
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Marinate the haloumi, mushrooms and capsicum for 1 hour with the juice of the lemon, the crushed garlic cloves, the dried oregano and the oil.
Thread onto skewers and grill 6 minutes, turning.
Serve in the warm pitas with the Greek yoghurt mixed with grated cucumber, plus tomato and onion.

veg.make_ahead: Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream up to 2 days ahead in the fridge; bake the potatoes and sear the cauliflower on the night

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C for an hour.
Cut the iceberg into four wedges and mash the blue cheese with some of the sour cream.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the oil until well browned, then finish in the oven alongside the potatoes.
Spoon the dressing over the wedges and load the potatoes with sour cream and chives.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the portobellos in the oil on both sides, then set aside.
Add the onion, carrots and celery and soften in the same pot.
Add the potatoes, stock and soy sauce, cover and braise at 160C.
Sit the mushrooms and lentils on top and braise until the potatoes are soft.
Serve with the juices.

veg.n: Big Red's Cup day roast mushroom rolls
veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms up to 1 day ahead, assemble fresh

steps.text: Rub the mushrooms with the oil, soy sauce, salt and pepper.
Roast at 200C until tender and juicy, then cool and slice.
Slice the onions.
Slowly fry the onions in butter.
Mix the sour cream with horseradish cream.
Split the rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with mushrooms, onions, rocket and sliced pickled beetroot.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days

steps.text: Dice the onions, garlic and celery.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches, then soften the vegetables.
Add the tomato paste, soy sauce, stock and lentils, return the mushrooms, cover and simmer.
Stir in the peas and spinach for the last 5 minutes so it turns green. Serve with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Soup up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Halve the tomatoes and roast with the onion, garlic and oil at 200C until softened and browned.
Transfer to a pot with the stock and simmer.
Blitz smooth with the cream and season with salt and pepper. Pour into warmed thermoses.
Make four peanut butter and jam sandwiches with the bread, cut off the crusts and serve with the soup.

veg.make_ahead: Make the bean chilli up to 3 days ahead in the fridge and reheat; griddle the hot dogs and steam the buns on the night

steps.text: Dice the onions.
Fry the mushrooms with one onion and the chilli powder in the oil until browned. Add the tomatoes and beans.
Simmer, mashing some of the beans, until thick.
Griddle the vegetarian hot dogs and steam the buns.
Fill the buns, spoon over chilli and top with cheddar and the diced raw onion.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onions and cook until soft, then stir in the tomato paste and smoked paprika.
Add the carrots, potatoes, beans, stock and thyme.
Put the lid on and cook over low coals or at 160C until thick.

veg.make_ahead: Press and cut the tofu and slice the vegetables up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; stir-fry on the night

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into thin strips and toss with a little of the soy and the cornflour.
Slice the cabbage, carrots and capsicum.
Heat the oil in a wok until smoking and stir-fry the tofu until browned.
Add the vegetables and ginger and stir-fry briefly.
Add the noodles, mushroom stir-fry sauce and remaining soy, toss and serve in bowls.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom pozole up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled and reheat; shred the cabbage and slice the radishes on the night

steps.text: Soak the chillies in hot water. Halve the onion and peel the garlic.
Simmer the stock with the onion and half the garlic.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until browned at the edges.
Blend the chillies with the rest of the garlic, stir into the pot with the mushrooms and hominy and simmer.
Shred the cabbage and slice the radishes.
Serve topped with cabbage, radish, oregano and lime.

veg.n: Gru's mushroom and ricotta meatballs in tomato sauce
veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, grated, for the meatballs
vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, grated, for serving

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in a little of the oil until dry, then cool.
Mix the mushrooms with the ricotta, egg, breadcrumbs, parmesan, parsley and seasoning. Roll into balls and chill.
Brown the balls gently in the rest of the oil in batches.
Add the garlic, tomatoes and basil to the pan and simmer the meatballs gently.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water while the sauce finishes.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and serve with extra parmesan.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mac and cheese up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled and reheat; roast the cauliflower on the night

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower in the oil and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, then brush with the barbecue sauce and bake until sticky.
Make mac and cheese from the macaroni, the butter, the flour, the milk and the cheddar.
Saute the silverbeet and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, add the lentils, tomatoes and wine and simmer until thick.
Make a bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the lentil sauce, lasagne sheets and bechamel in a dish, finishing with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes.
Rest for 20 minutes before cutting.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil, add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and vinegar and simmer until thick.
Make a bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the lentil sauce, lasagne sheets and bechamel in a dish, finishing with mozzarella.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes.
Rest for 20 minutes before cutting.

veg.n: London Christmas roast with mushroom and sage stuffing
veg.make_ahead: Roll can be assembled the day before, roast fresh

steps.text: Fry the chopped onion and mushrooms with the sage in a little of the oil until dry. Mix with the chestnuts and breadcrumbs for stuffing.
Lay out the pastry, spread with the stuffing, roll up and seal, then brush with beaten egg.
Peel the potatoes and trim the sprouts.
Roast the potatoes in the rest of the oil at 200C, adding the roll after 20 minutes.
Roast the sprouts for the last stretch.
Slice the roll and serve with cranberry sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble and bake when needed

steps.text: Dice the onion and grate the carrots.
Brown the mushrooms with the onion and carrot in the oil, then stir in the tomato paste.
Add the lentils, peas and stock and simmer until thick. Season with salt and pepper.
Peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Spread the lentils in a dish and top with the mash.
Bake at 200C until golden.

veg.make_ahead: Rub the mushrooms with the oil and spices up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; roast, glaze and grill to serve

steps.text: Halve the king oyster mushrooms lengthways and score the cut sides. Rub with the oil, salt, pepper and smoked paprika.
Roast at 200C until browned and tender.
Brush with the barbecue sauce and grill until sticky.
Boil the corn cobs and toss in the butter.
Serve with the buttered corn and the coleslaw mixed with mayonnaise.

veg.make_ahead: Shallot butter up to 3 days

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Simmer the shallots with the wine until almost dry. Cool, then mix into the butter with the salt and chill.
Cut the potatoes into frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in the neutral oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Season the cauliflower steaks, sear hard in a hot pan with the searing oil, then roast at 220C until tender.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp. Salt lightly.
Top the cauliflower steaks with the shallot red wine butter. Serve with frites.

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Simmer the shallots with the water and vinegar until almost dry. Cool, then mix into the butter with the salt and chill.
Cut the potatoes into frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in the neutral oil at 140C, then drain and cool.
Season the cauliflower steaks, sear hard in a hot pan with the searing oil, then roast at 220C until tender.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp. Salt lightly.
Top the cauliflower steaks with the shallot butter. Serve with frites.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soften the leeks and onion in butter.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer until tender.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil until crisp, then toss with the smoked paprika and a pinch of salt.
Blend the soup with the cream until silky.
Top with the smoky mushrooms and chives and serve with crusty bread.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the olives and portion the toppings up to 1 day ahead; stretch, top and bake on the night

steps.text: Heat the oven and a tray to 250C.
Stretch the dough into two rounds and spread with crushed tomatoes.
Cover with mozzarella, then arrange plant-based pepperoni like planets and olive slices like craters.
Bake on the hot tray until blistered.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Soften the onions and garlic.
Add the chipotle, cumin, cocoa, tomatoes, beans, sweet potato, stock and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer gently until thick.
Serve topped with sour cream and cheddar.

veg.make_ahead: Make the plant-based chilli up to 3 days ahead, keep chilled, or freeze up to 1 month; reheat, then grill the frankfurts and assemble on the night

ingredients.item: onions, 1 diced for the chilli and 1 finely diced to serve

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with the diced onion in the oil, then add the cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, passata and a splash of water.
Simmer until thick.
Grill the vegetarian frankfurts, turning, and toast the split buns.
Fill the buns with frankfurts and chilli, top with cheddar and grill until melted.
Finish with raw diced onion and a squeeze of mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Cook the onions and mix the burger sauce up to 2 days ahead, chilled; roll the mince balls up to 1 day ahead and cook on the night

steps.text: Slowly cook the sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise, the tomato sauce, the mustard and the chopped pickles.
Roll the plant-based mince into 8 balls.
On a very hot barbecue plate brushed with the vegetable oil, smash each flat, season and cook 2 minutes.
Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute.
Toast the potato buns, spread with sauce and stack the patties each with onion and pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Dough needs 1 to 2 days in the fridge

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt and water and knead. Divide into two balls.
Refrigerate covered to cold-ferment for a day or two.
Bring to room temperature.
Heat a pizza steel at the oven's maximum, about 250 to 275C.
Slice the vegetarian sausages and pan-fry in the oil until browned, then crumble.
Stretch the dough thin into two pizzas. Top with tomatoes, mozzarella and sausage.
Bake each on the steel until crisp and cooked, then cut into wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Bake the eggplant slabs up to 1 day ahead and chill; glaze under the grill and mix the slaw just before serving

steps.text: Cut the eggplants into thick lengthways slabs and score the flesh. Rub with the oil, salt, pepper and smoked paprika and wrap in foil.
Bake at 180C until soft right through.
Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill.
Toss the shredded cabbage with the mayonnaise for slaw.

veg.make_ahead: Mix the hearts of palm and egg topping up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry the bread and pile on the topping just before serving

steps.text: Chop the hearts of palm and eggs into small pieces.
Fold with the mayo, creme fraiche, dill, lemon juice, horseradish and capers.
Fry the bread in butter until golden.
Pile the mixture on top and finish with extra dill.

veg.n: Haywood Ranch grilled mushrooms and haloumi with beans
veg.make_ahead: Mix the salsa up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; rub and grill the mushrooms and haloumi on the night

steps.text: Rub the portobellos with the oil, salt, pepper and garlic.
Grill over coals, gill side up first, until tender. Grill the haloumi until marked on both sides.
Warm the beans. Mix the tomatoes, onion, coriander and lime for salsa.
Slice the mushrooms and serve with the haloumi, beans and salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and tofu and toss in the soy mix up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; stir-fry to serve

steps.text: Toss the tofu and mushrooms with the light soy, cornflour and sesame oil.
Gently separate the noodles.
Stir-fry the tofu and mushrooms in two batches in a hot wok with some of the oil and set aside.
Fry the noodles in the rest of the oil.
Add the bean sprouts, sliced spring onions and dark soy. Return the tofu and mushrooms and toss over high heat until piping hot.

veg.n: Fried cauliflower, pizza and tacos dinner
veg.make_ahead: Cauliflower can soak in the buttermilk the day before

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower in the buttermilk.
Dredge in seasoned flour and fry at 175C until crisp and tender.
Stretch the dough, top with sauce and mozzarella and bake at 230C until bubbling.
Brown the plant-based mince with the cumin and taco spices in a little of the oil.
Fill the taco shells and put everything out together.

veg.n: Light horse camp mushroom and stout stew
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the onions and carrots. Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions, carrots and garlic and cook, then stir in the flour and tomato paste.
Add the stout, stock, lentils, thyme and bay leaves, cover and simmer gently until thick.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

veg_af.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Dice the onions and carrots. Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the onions, carrots and garlic and cook, then stir in the flour and tomato paste.
Add the stock, extra stock, vinegar, sugar, lentils, thyme and bay leaves, cover and simmer gently until thick.
Peel and chop the potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Slice the mushrooms and onion up to 1 day ahead; sear and finish the sauce on the night and cook the noodles last

steps.text: Slice the onion.
Sear the mushrooms in the oil in batches until golden and set aside.
Cook the onion until soft and stir in the paprika and soy sauce.
Stir in the sour cream and return the mushrooms, warming through without boiling.
Cook the noodles, toss in butter and serve the stroganoff over the top.

veg.make_ahead: Best fresh, or reheat the noodles in a pan

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and toss in the cornflour. Cut the broccoli and slice the capsicum.
Stir fry the tofu in the oil until golden.
Add the broccoli and capsicum and cook until bright.
Toss through the noodles with soy sauce and honey until sticky.
Pack into takeaway boxes.

veg.make_ahead: Apple sauce up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and score the flesh in a deep criss-cross.
Rub with half the oil, the salt and some chopped sage, then roast at 220C cut side up.
Add the potatoes tossed in the rest of the oil and roast until the pumpkin is tender and the edges are crisp.
Meanwhile cook the apples with a little sage and the sugar to a chunky sauce.
Fry the rest of the sage leaves in the butter until crisp and pour over the pumpkin before carving.

veg.n: RST Video smoked tofu, egg and cheese
veg.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Fry the smoked tofu slices in the oil until browned and crisp at the edges.
Fry the eggs.
Stack tofu, egg and cheese into the rolls, add tomato sauce, salt and pepper.
Wrap in foil for a couple of minutes to melt.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead, sear the mushrooms fresh

steps.text: Halve the potatoes and dice the shallot. Score the cut sides of the mushrooms.
Roast the potatoes in half the oil at 220C.
Sear the mushrooms cut side down in the rest of the oil until deep golden, flip and cook until tender. Set aside.
Fry the shallot in the pan, add the wine and reduce, then add the cream, Dijon and tarragon and simmer.
Cook the beans and toss in butter.
Return the mushrooms to the sauce and serve with the potatoes and beans.

veg_af.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day ahead, sear the mushrooms fresh

steps.text: Halve the potatoes and dice the shallot. Score the cut sides of the mushrooms.
Roast the potatoes in half the oil at 220C.
Sear the mushrooms cut side down in the rest of the oil until deep golden, flip and cook until tender. Set aside.
Fry the shallot in the pan, add the stock and vinegar and reduce, then add the cream, Dijon and tarragon and simmer.
Cook the beans and toss in butter.
Return the mushrooms to the sauce and serve with the potatoes and beans.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Soften the onions in the oil with the cumin and cinnamon.
Add the stock, tomatoes, pumpkin and chickpeas.
Cover and simmer until the pumpkin is tender and the stew is thick.
Prepare the couscous as the packet says.
Serve the stew over the couscous with the feta.

veg.make_ahead: Scrub, rub and wrap the celeriac up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; roast on the day

steps.text: Scrub the celeriac and rub with the crushed garlic cloves, thyme, half the oil and salt. Wrap each in foil.
Roast at 200C until a knife slides in easily.
Roast the potatoes in chunks in the rest of the oil alongside.
Unwrap, baste with the butter and roast until browned.
Carve at the table with the horseradish cream.

veg.make_ahead: Stew up to 1 day, add the haloumi when reheating

steps.text: Dice the onion, capsicum and potatoes and crush the garlic.
Fry the onion, capsicum and garlic in oil.
Add smoked paprika, crushed tomatoes, stock, miso and potatoes and simmer until the potato is nearly tender.
Add the beans and haloumi and simmer until warmed through.
Stir in parsley.
Toast the sourdough, rub with garlic and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the onion.
Sear the mushrooms in batches in a hot pan with the oil, then remove.
Fry the onion in half the butter.
Add the paprika, Dijon and stock and simmer.
Stir in the sour cream and the mushrooms and warm through without boiling.
Cook the egg noodles, toss in the rest of the butter and dill and serve under the mushrooms.

veg.n: Dex's Diner mushroom patty melts and fries
veg.make_ahead: Onions and patty mix up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Cook the onions slowly in a little of the butter until golden.
Fry the mushrooms until dry, then mash with the black beans, breadcrumbs and egg.
Shape into 4 thin patties and sear in a little oil. Layer on rye with the onions and Swiss.
Butter the outside of the bread and grill until melted.
Fry the potato chips in the oil on a low heat until soft, then again on a high heat until golden. Serve with pickles.

veg.n: Whoville roast beast loaf with crispy potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Loaf can be shaped 1 day ahead

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms with the garlic and rosemary in the olive oil until dry, then mix with the lentils, walnuts, breadcrumbs and eggs and press into a lined loaf tin.
Parboil the potatoes, drain, rough up and toss in the vegetable oil.
Roast the potatoes and the loaf at 200C, adding the carrots tossed in honey for the last part.
Rest the loaf.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour, then the stock and soy and simmer to make gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Dice the onion and keep a quarter aside for topping. Mince the garlic.
Fry the rest of the onion in the oil with the garlic, then add the plant-based mince and brown well.
Stir in the tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, tomatoes and water and simmer. Season with salt.
Bake the fries as directed on the packet.
Griddle the vegetarian hot dogs until piping hot and warm the buns. Fill with hot dogs and chilli and finish with onion and mustard.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil.
Soften the onions, then add the carrots, potatoes, pearl barley, beans and stock.
Cover and simmer gently until the barley is tender and the stew is thick.
Serve with slices of the Italian loaf to stretch it further.

veg.n: Dr. Evil's one million dollar cauliflower steak Diane
veg.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks and slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead; sear and make the sauce just before serving

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Season the cauliflower steaks, sear in the vegetable oil in a very hot pan until browned, then finish in the oven with the fries.
Melt the butter in the same pan and fry the mushrooms and shallot.
Add the brandy and let it bubble off, then add the soy sauce, mustard and cream and simmer.
Pour the sauce over the cauliflower and serve with the fries and watercress.

veg_af.n: Dr. Evil's one million dollar cauliflower steak Diane
veg_af.make_ahead: Cut the cauliflower steaks and slice the mushrooms up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; sear and finish the sauce on the night

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks
apple juice with 1 tsp cider vinegar

steps.text: Bake the fries at 220C until crisp.
Season the cauliflower steaks, sear in the vegetable oil in a very hot pan until browned, then finish in the oven with the fries.
Melt the butter in the same pan and fry the mushrooms and shallot.
Add the apple juice mix and let it bubble, then add the soy sauce, mustard and cream and simmer.
Pour the sauce over the cauliflower and serve with the fries and watercress.

veg.n: Usual suspects chickpea and cauliflower tagine
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Brown the cauliflower in the oil.
Soften the sliced onions with the ginger and saffron.
Add the chickpeas, cauliflower, water, chopped preserved lemon rind and olives and simmer.
Pour the couscous into the boiling stock, cover for a few minutes and fluff.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: large eggplants, cut into big chunks

steps.text: Brown the eggplant in the oil in batches.
Stir in the harissa and cumin.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and water.
Cover and simmer gently until the eggplant is meltingly soft.
Warm the flatbread and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Make the lentil and mushroom mix up to 1 day ahead, pressed into the tin and covered in the fridge; glaze, bake and mash on the night

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk. Grate the onion and fry with the mushrooms in the oil until dry.
Roughly mash the lentils, mix with the breadcrumbs, mushrooms and egg, and press into a loaf tin.
Glaze with the tomato sauce mixed with the sugar and bake at 180C.
Peel and boil the potatoes and mash. Cook the peas.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Score the eggplant flesh, brush with half the oil and roast cut side up at 220C for 20 minutes.
Toss the potatoes in the rest of the oil and salt and put in the oven alongside.
Brush the eggplant with Dijon, press on the parsley, breadcrumbs and parmesan and roast until golden.
Boil the peas with the mint, drain and blitz with the butter. Plate the eggplant neatly with the potatoes and peas.

veg.make_ahead: Best cooked just before serving; fry the hash browns up to 1 hour ahead and hold in a 120C oven, then sear the portobellos and fry the eggs fresh

steps.text: Grate the potatoes and squeeze dry.
Fry as hash brown cakes in half the butter until crisp.
Season the portobellos with cracked pepper and sear in the oil until browned and tender.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the butter and toast the bread.
Serve two mushrooms each with two eggs, hash browns and buttered toast.

veg.n: Wilee's halal cart tofu over rice
veg.make_ahead: Marinate the tofu slabs up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; mix the white sauce up to 2 days ahead and cook the rice and tofu on the night

steps.text: Cut the tofu into thick slabs and marinate in the lemon juice, oregano, cumin and coriander.
Cook the rice with the turmeric.
Mix the yoghurt, mayo, vinegar, sugar and pepper into a white sauce.
Griddle the tofu in the oil until crisp on both sides, then chop.
Serve on shredded lettuce with rice, white sauce and hot sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Simmer a day ahead, roast fresh

ingredients.item: small savoy cabbage, cut into 4 thick wedges

steps.text: Simmer the cabbage wedges with the onion, bay leaves and caraway seeds in the stock until just tender.
Lift out, pat very dry, brush with the oil and rub with salt.
Roast at 220C until the edges blister and char.
Boil the potatoes and toss with butter and parsley. Warm the sauerkraut with a little of the cooking liquid.
Serve with wholegrain mustard.

veg.n: Smoked tofu, spinach and gruyere strata
veg.make_ahead: Assemble the night before, bake fresh

steps.text: Butter a 2L baking dish.
Tear the bread and layer with the diced smoked tofu, spinach and grated gruyere.
Whisk the eggs with milk, Dijon, salt and pepper and pour over. Press down and cover.
Chill for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Bake at 180C until puffed and golden.
Rest before serving with tomato relish.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, cut into thick slabs

steps.text: Marinate the tofu in the pineapple juice, soy, ginger and garlic.
Grill the tofu in the oil until golden, turning.
Simmer the marinade until reduced to a glaze and brush over.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk and water.
Serve the tofu over the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk up to 4 hours ahead in the fridge; dredge and fry on the night

steps.text: Soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk with the hot sauce and the salt.
Dredge in the plain flour mixed with the paprika, the garlic powder and the pepper.
Fry at 180C until deep golden and crisp.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and some of the milk.
For gravy, whisk a little of the frying oil with some flour, then the rest of the milk, simmer until thick and season with lots of pepper.
